verses.text: Moses called all Israel together and said to them: "Listen, Israel, to the rules and laws I am announcing to you today. Learn them and be sure to obey them.
The LORD our God made a covenant with us at Mount Sinai.
The LORD did not make this covenant only with our ancestors, but with us, all of us who are alive here today.
The LORD spoke to you face to face from the fire on the mountain.
At that time I stood between the LORD and you to tell you what the LORD said, because you were afraid of the fire and did not go up the mountain. He said:
'I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt, the land where you were slaves.
Do not have any other gods except me.
Do not make an idol for yourself in the shape of anything in the sky above, on the earth below, or in the water under the earth.
Do not bow down to idols or worship them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God. I punish children for the sins of their parents who hate me, to the third and fourth generation.
But I show faithful love to thousands of generations of those who love me and keep my commands.
Do not misuse the name of the LORD your God, for the LORD will punish anyone who misuses his name.
Keep the Sabbath day holy, as the LORD your God has commanded you.
You have six days to do all your work.

But the seventh day is a Sabbath for the LORD your God. On that day no one may do any work: not you, your son or daughter, your male or female servant, your ox or donkey or any of your animals, or the foreigner living in your towns. Your male and female servants must rest just as you do.

Remember that you were slaves in Egypt, and the LORD your God brought you out from there with his mighty hand and powerful arm. That is why the LORD your God has commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
Honour your father and your mother, as the LORD your God has commanded you, so that you may live long and all may go well with you in the land the LORD your God is giving you.
Do not murder.
Do not commit adultery.
Do not steal.
Do not tell lies about your neighbour in court.
Do not want to take your neighbour's wife. Do not long for your neighbour's house, his land, his male or female servant, his ox or donkey, or anything else that belongs to your neighbour.'

The LORD spoke these words in a loud voice to your whole community at the mountain, from the fire, the cloud, and the thick darkness. He said nothing more. Then he wrote them on two stone tablets and gave them to me.
When you heard the voice from the darkness, while the mountain was blazing with fire, all the leaders of your tribes and your elders came to me.
You said, 'The LORD our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice from the fire. Today we have seen that God can speak with a person and that person can still live.
But now, why should we die? This great fire will burn us up. If we hear the voice of the LORD our God any longer, we will die.
What human being has ever heard the voice of the living God speaking from a fire, as we have, and lived?
You go near and listen to everything the LORD our God says. Then tell us whatever the LORD our God tells you. We will listen and obey.'
The LORD heard what you said to me, and the LORD said to me, 'I have heard what these people said to you. Everything they said is good.
Oh, if only they would always have hearts like this, to fear me and keep all my commands! Then all would go well with them and their children forever.
Go and tell them to go back to their tents.
But you stay here with me, and I will give you all the commands, rules, and laws you must teach them. They must obey them in the land I am giving them to own.'
So be careful to do what the LORD your God has commanded you. Do not turn away from it to the right or to the left.
Walk in all the ways the LORD your God has commanded you. Then you will live, all will go well with you, and you will live long in the land you will own."
